scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build:backend && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.package:dist: npm run build:backend && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:backend && npm run build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.package:linux:arm64: npm run build:backend -- --target=linux/arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --arm64
scripts.package:win: npm run build:backend -- --target=windows/amd64 && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:win:zip: npm run build:backend -- --target=windows/amd64 && npm run build && electron-builder --win zip
